title: iPRA: scope elimination and a frontier audit
positive_result: Every reachable control invocation satisfies k = 1 - len(g). Reconstructing k at entry and omitting it from recursive calls preserves finite certificate traces exactly, with the local scope-phase decrement retained.

proof_status.scope_invariant: written proof, independently reviewed against source
proof_status.bi_interpretation: inherited unchanged public calculus and arithmetic bridge

nonclaims: No reduction below the surveyed complexity frontier.
